title: vaultGatewayPolicy
responsibility: Decides whether a mediated Credential Vault browser gateway operation is allowed for a lease.

inputs.name: vaultGatewayPolicy.scope
inputs.description: The lease scope from the approved recipe action: origins, redirect origins, read or write mode, allowed and denied path patterns and download file types.

inputs.name: vaultGatewayPolicy.operation
inputs.description: The requested gateway call: its operation name, an optional target URL and an optional download file type.

inputs.name: vaultUrlPolicy.scope
inputs.description: The lease scope from the approved recipe action.

inputs.name: vaultUrlPolicy.target
inputs.description: Absolute URL of a navigation, redirect or form target.

inputs.name: pathMatches.pattern
inputs.description: Recipe path pattern; * matches one segment and a trailing /** matches any remainder.

outputs.name: readOperations
outputs.description: Gateway operations a read-only lease may call.

outputs.name: writeOperations
outputs.description: Gateway operations that need a lease approved with write mode.

outputs.name: vaultGatewayPolicy
outputs.description: Allowed, or refused with a reason the session can show.

outputs.name: vaultUrlPolicy
outputs.description: Allowed when the target is on an approved origin, outside the protected key, token, recovery, 2FA and session pages, not denied and on an allowed path; otherwise refused with a reason.

outputs.name: pathMatches
outputs.description: True when the path matches the pattern.
